title: Zero-shot E0 (ms8) on D2 isolated sets: CASIA zh, CASIA en, HPL Tamil (500 units each, d2_pilot_v1, seed 2026)

parameters.gpu: gpuidle, 1 GPU, any type with compute capability >= 8.0 (Features constraint set via scontrol on pending jobs; in-job guard requeues off Pascal nodes); GPU type per shard in samples/shard_log.tsv
parameters.requeue: Slurm --requeue; finished shards are skipped on restart, partial shards are rewritten from scratch (same seed)

conditions.rendered: E0 training renderer: uhwr_eval.render_image 64x64, 2 px, anti-aliased (white-on-black after OuhdlE0Dataset inversion)
conditions.d2: D2 renderer row (N14): unit_features.render_input f=4 (256x256, 8 px, AA) then cv2.INTER_AREA to 64x64

parameters.scoring: e0_score.py e0: uhwr_eval.score native + standardised, LPIPS off; summary = e0_score.py summary with sample_id = writer id, so the 95% CIs are writer-cluster bootstraps (B=2000, seed 0)
parameters.paired: paired_compare.py d2 minus rendered per set, writer-cluster CI

smoke.note: 64 units casia_zh both renderers; 0 scoring errors

notes: E0 was trained on RTL Urdu only; CASIA zh/en and Tamil are LTR scripts and are fed unmirrored (zero-shot as is).
The isolated-unit GT space is UF.to_eval_space (clean_ink + fit_transform_unit), identical to the D2 geometric pilot.
GT for the sequence target (seq) was encoded only because OuhdlE0Dataset requires it; sampling does not use it.
deviations: D2-renderer input is down-sampled from 256 px to E0's 64 px input with cv2.INTER_AREA (E0 takes 64x64 only).
code_history: e0q_code_v2.tgz (sha256 1da32298...) was live when the first jobs were submitted; v3 (eb32b475...) only raises the GPU guard from cc>=7.0 to cc>=8.0 after a V100 CUDA failure. Job scripts are unchanged between v2 and v3.
